name: Mother
source:
Mother of Sayane. Doctor of Engineering, works in a laboratory. She so busy and weak at the end of the day, the majority of housework has to be done by her daughter.
She likes coffee milk.

[Edited and translated from the [url=http://www.ray-software.net/tokihako/index.html]official website[/url]]
